groups.title: Text
groups.summary: Markup, rules and pixel lettering. Text is measured in terminal cells, so emoji and CJK keep the grid.

groups.title: Layout
groups.summary: Containers that place other widgets. Any widget can sit inside any container, including a live dashboard.

groups.title: Status and progress
groups.summary: The widgets a live session updates: facts, steps, trees, bars, phases, spinners and the log region.

groups.title: Charts
groups.summary: Bars, stacked bars, sparklines, histograms and braille line and scatter charts, all scaled to their cells.

examples.title: Text and markup
examples.summary: Spectre-style markup: theme roles, colours and decorations, reduced for each tier.
examples.powershell:
Write-ConsoleText -Markup '[bold]Deployed[/] in [accent]48 s[/]: [pass]√ 12 passed[/] [warn]▲ 2 warned[/] [fail]✗ 1 failed[/]'
Write-ConsoleText -Markup '[italic]Decorations:[/] [bold]bold[/] [dim]dim[/] [underline]underline[/] [strikethrough]struck[/] [invert] invert [/]'
examples.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

Write-ConsoleText -Markup '[bold]Deployed[/] in [accent]48 s[/]: [pass]√ 12 passed[/] [warn]▲ 2 warned[/] [fail]✗ 1 failed[/]'
Write-ConsoleText -Markup '[italic]Decorations:[/] [bold]bold[/] [dim]dim[/] [underline]underline[/] [strikethrough]struck[/] [invert] invert [/]'

frame.dark: Deployed in 48 s: √ 12 passed ▲ 2 warned ✗ 1 failed Decorations: bold dim underline struck invert
frame.light: Deployed in 48 s: √ 12 passed ▲ 2 warned ✗ 1 failed Decorations: bold dim underline struck invert

new Rule().Show();

examples.title: Progress
examples.summary: Labelled bars with a percentage and a count, in line or block shape.
examples.csharp: Terminal.Write(new Rows().Add(new ProgressBar("Build") { Value = 64, Total = 100 }).Add(new ProgressBar("Tests") { Value = 412, Total = 530 }).Add(new ProgressBar("Docs") { Value = 100, Total = 100, Status = StatusKind.Pass }).Add(new ProgressBar("Upload") { Value = 3, Total = 8, Shape = BarShape.Block }));
examples.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

New-ConsoleRows -Content {
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Build' -Value 64 -Total 100
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Tests' -Value 412 -Total 530
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Docs' -Value 100 -Total 100 -Status Pass
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Upload' -Value 3 -Total 8 -Shape Block
} | Show-Console

examples.title: Phases
examples.summary: A pipeline of stages: done, running and waiting.
examples.csharp:
Terminal.Write(new Phases()
    .Set("Discover", StatusKind.Pass, detail: "2.1s")
    .Set("Collect", StatusKind.Pass, detail: "14s")
    .Set("Evaluate", StatusKind.Running, detail: "64%")
    .Set("Report", StatusKind.Pending));

frame.light: ✓ Discover 2.1s › ✓ Collect 14s › ⠋ Evaluate 64% › ○ Report
